reviews.text: I received two quotes before my pet's surgery. Each time, the price increased. Despite everything going well and as planned, they found a way to inflate the final bill even further. They can take up to two weeks to reply to an email, and there's never anyone answering the phone at reception, which makes it difficult to get answers for post-operative follow-up.
Amazing job thease guys do. Great place that seems to care.
Professional service, reasonable prices, conscientious veterinarians, and highly competent technicians. In my opinion, THE best clinic!
Excellent service

Date of visit: October 5, 2026

I have been to this clinic a couple of times and my dog already has an established patient file here. Unfortunately, my recent experience trying to pick up medication was highly disappointing.

I called ahead to order seasonal allergy pills so they could be prepared for pickup. The receptionist was unhelpful and unwilling to find a solution, offering various excuses such as "technicians are on break" and stating that they require a 24-hour notice. Counting out 20 pills and placing them in a bottle is a straightforward task, especially since the clinic explicitly charges a dispensing fee on the bill for this exact service.

Hoping for some flexibility given the situation, I drove to the clinic an hour and a half after my call. Despite explaining multiple times that my dog was actively suffering and urgently needed his medication, the receptionist refused to even check with the technicians to see if the order could be expedited.

There was a complete lack of customer service, empathy, and professionalism. Rather than following a consistent policy, it felt as though decisions were being made based on the staff member's mood.
It is incredibly discouraging to see this level of care and customer experience from a veterinary clinic.
Welcome to Montreal!

I had a very good experience with the veterinarian. They were very kind, attentive, and treated both my pet and me with a lot of care and gentleness. The clinic is clean, nice, and the prices are very reasonable.

The only negative part of my experience was the reception during my first visit. The person at the front desk was quite rude and short with me when I asked a couple of questions, which honestly surprised me.

Despite that small issue, I would still recommend this place because of the great veterinary care, the clean environment, and the affordable prices.

Today I took my girl there for the first time. I had great experience. Dr. Ebrahimi visited my girl. She was very understanding and quite helpful in regards to my girl's specific situation. I definitely will go back there if needed. %100 recommended.

Today, Mac, our faithful companion of almost 14 years, left us. It was heartbreaking and far too soon (as always in these situations), but thanks to the kindness, humanity, and gentleness of everyone involved (without exception), we got through this difficult time, not without tears, but with acceptance. Thank you, Marie-Eve Bossé, and the entire team who were there that day.

We are very satisfied with the Point Saint-Charles Veterinary Clinic. The entire team is incredibly kind, caring, and always ready to help. We have always been able to receive excellent care for our little dog without any difficulty.
Excellent service from all the staff. Very kind and helpful. Highly recommend.
Great people who really love and cares about your dog, they are always very kind and giving great advises

The vet with the glasses and curly hair was really kind, she took the time to understand my dog’s situation, evaluated her in a calmly way so my dog would be more comfortable and assed and proceeded with the surgery quickly to help my dog out. Everyone at the clinic was nice, the aftercare nurse as well, they even send out multiple emails for post check ups until we go back to get the stitches removed. I highly recommend this vet, the prices are affordable compared to other vets around the city.

I don't trust easily, but this clinic has earned my trust with my three cats. They are truly dedicated to their mission of helping patients and aren't in it for the money.

The only *minor* drawback is that once the consultation is over and medication is dispensed, you sometimes have to wait ten minutes to pay the bill. My cats are just itching to get home (lol). But I understand they're very busy, and everyone is doing their best, including the receptionists.

Thank you for your excellent service!

Photo: My cat not happy to be at the vet's.

I brought my Miniature Schnauzer into Clinique Vétérinaire de Pointe-St-Charles for a much-needed, overdue comprehensive exam. While we were there, we also needed to take care of a few routine items; including getting his tick and flea prevention, administering a necessary shot, and getting his claws trimmed.
From start to finish, the entire experience was absolute top tier. The veterinarian was super nice, incredibly friendly, and exceptionally gentle with my dog. They were remarkably thorough and professional, guiding us through every step of the checkup in a timely and efficient manner. After the exam, two veterinary technicians stepped in to trim my dog's nails. They were equally kind and professional; handling my timid and reluctant pup with immense patience and care.
Finding a neighborhood vet you can genuinely trust with your pets is such a relief. Pet care is always somewhat expensive no matter where you go; but considering the stellar level of service and personal care provided here, I think their prices are entirely fair and reasonable. I am extremely happy to have found this clinic right in my neighborhood and will definitely be returning for all future vet visits!

The staff is very dedicated to animal welfare. They offer follow-up via email/text. Easy to reach with questions.

I highly recommend Dr. Bossé.

STAY AWAY. We brought our sweet baby cat and they tortured her. They sent us home without telling us anything , without any painkillers or warning  of what they have done will be so painful that a cat will not be able to walk , will be dripping and peeing blood when that was never the case to begin with. We asked why she may be peeing outside the littler was all we brought her in for! No calls, no follow ups, no results sent to us. We had to emergency bring her to another vet .. she is in excruciating pain without the ability to drink, eat or walk. Unfortunately this happened to us but hopefully not to your fur baby.

2026 updated review: After a 3-year stint in BC, I'm back in Montreal now with two cats instead of one. It was a no brainer for me to return to Pointe Vet given the wonderful care Chaï and I received in the past (2020-2022). They gladly took on my 2nd cat (new to them) and even offered a double check up appointment when we returned such that both cats could be seen in the same visit. Today, I had to go in semi-urgently for GI issues in Chaï, and Dr. Bossé was absolutely wonderful! She took the time to answer all my questions and establish a clear plan of action that reassured my worries. Again, wonderful vet!

Past review: I find myself writing a review for Pointe Vet because I truly want others to know how kind and caring Dr. Drooker is to both his pet patients and their human parents!!

When I first adopted my adult cat from the SPCA in May 2020, it was hard to find a vet amidst the pandemic. Most were still closed at the time but I did my research and knew I wanted to open Chaï's file at this clinic based on the reviews. I was not disappointed at all.

For the past two years, Dr. Drooker has handled Chaï's case and done so beautifully. He does not push to do unnecessary (often stressful!) test for the cat (especially as she is older now) and takes all the time to truly discuss every issue and concern with you. Over the past two years, he took the time either by phone or in person to answer any and all questions of mine, even when it wasn't my appointment time and I happened to see him in the clinic while picking up a prescription. He remembered Chaï and her condition and made himself available for me to ask follow up questions. He even prescribed an antibiotic on the spot for her chin acne despite me not having an appointment!

Furthermore, it is true: the prices at the clinic are VERY reasonable. When I first told my mom about the consultation fee and then the dental surgery estimate that I was given here, she was shocked at how good they were, being a long time (40+ years) cat owner herself.

All in all, I truly am so grateful for Dr. Drooker's care as I navigate the vet market in Vancouver following a recent move. I hope I can find a comparable vet as I read through hundreds of Vancouver veterinary clinic reviews.

Finally, to address some points made in other reviews that could be included but nonetheless do not affect my 5-star rating of the place:

- It is difficult to get ahold of them over the phone. It seemed much easier back in 2020; now they send you straight to voicemail which is frustrating. Perhaps something to consider changing on their part as it can take some time to get a call back from the receptionist.

- There is one receptionist that can be rude/condescending honestly. I have dealt with her a few times and have had better service with literally anyone else at the clinic. This did not stop me from returning however as the actual cat/pet care is fantastic.

- While I do follow all COVID procedures and recommendations, it does suck that (still) in 2022 you cannot go in the consultation room with your pet. This is not so much a criticism as a fact. I understand the room is small and I get that they want to protect the staff as they are a small clinic and a covid outbreak would probably mean the clinic closing abruptly and pet appointments being cancelled. However, it is strange as they don't uphold social distancing when they come discuss with you in the lobby.
Very friendly staff and calm vibes. Doesn't feel sterile
We always receive excellent service at this clinic! The staff is friendly and provides outstanding service.

Nothing but pleasant and professional experiences with the Pointe Vet. Dr Drooker is always so great with our cats, and incredibly kind and compassionate when discussing cat care and options. All of the staff make stressful vet visits and dental surgery a lot easier on cats and humans alike. Thanks Pointe Vet!

I just went for my first visit with my puppy and they are absolutely amazing. The vet is so caring, and extremely honest. They really take the time so sit with you and explain everything. Everyone is really friendly

EDIT: After 5.5 years as a client, I’m leaving this review following a recent appointment and the clinic’s response to my concerns.

The appointment felt more like being interrogated for faults than a routine checkup. The vet commented on my dog’s weight in a way that felt judgmental rather than medically concerned — despite the technician having just noted she was healthy. The tone throughout was passive aggressive.

When a dental cleaning was recommended, I was quoted double what I paid the same clinic two years ago, with my dog’s teeth described as “moderate to severe.” I went to another clinic instead, who scanned her, found nothing severe, and charged the same price I had paid here two years ago. When I requested a cost breakdown from this clinic, it was identical to the one from two years ago — no real explanation for the price increase.

I emailed the clinic directly rather than posting a review. Their response never once addressed the pricing discrepancy or the contradicting dental assessment. After 5.5 years as a client raising a specific billing concern, I received a note about communication styles and an offer to forward my dog’s records elsewhere.
Very human approach, impeccable service

I received professional and transparent service. I had consulted her about a change in my pet's appetite, but a serious condition was discovered. I was notified immediately, even before the other tests I had consented to were performed.
Dr. Bossé demonstrated transparency and objectivity in helping me make the best decision regarding my pet's end-of-life care.
Very friendly and professional staff. They are very honest not like most vets.
condescending, rude, and dangerously incompetent
This establishment do NOT care about the well being of animals. Only money. Do NOT recommend

Doctors are nice and competent, the service has always been pleasant with them. I would recommend better customer service training for the redhead secretary with the glasses in the front; she’s very passive aggressive and impatient. I get things may seem silly upon having a work routine, but us as clients don’t know how things work always, so I’d appreciate a kinder, friendlier attitude as is not very polite to be met with attitude.
Very professional

We are new clients at the Pointe Saint-Charles veterinary clinic. Our dog Vivianne had some minor health issues last week, and they were incredible at our first appointment! They even checked on our dog as soon as they reopened on Monday morning. I greatly appreciate the service we received and highly recommend them!

We’ve been coming here for many years and always have a great experience. The staff is very kind, accommodating, and patient, especially since my dog is scared of the vet. They’ve allowed us to use a separate “cozy” room to wait and be isolated from other pets. I find that they’re also well priced for the area.

The staff at this clinic are absolutely wonderful. I drive all the way from the east end just to go here. The medical staff are understanding, empathetic and great listeners. I’ve been going here for years and I’ll continue going here for more to come.
Not a place to buy dogs food
Wonderful service and way more affordable than the options in our neighborhood. Our pup had a surgery there and was very well taken care of.
Good vet with a carrying staff.
Great vet, he is really helpful and takes the time to explain. But the front desk is slow and rude
Excellent  care by Dr Floca and team. The follow-ups  were greatly appreciated.  I was on metro when you called today so I'm sorry I could not express fully my thanks. So thank you!
Excellent team – caring, humane and sincere.

I’m honestly grateful to have found this veterinary clinic. Even though there’s a vet just two minutes from our place, my partner and I are more than happy to drive the 15 minutes it takes to get here because the service is absolutely impeccable.

I can call or text anytime if there’s ever a question or concern about our dog, Winston, and the team is always quick to respond with care and compassion. They are always  professional and caring and clearly very dedicated.

The staff here are not only incredibly competent, but also so genuinely kind that Winny absolutely loves visiting. He’s never nervous or scared—he knows he’ll be greeted with treats, affection, and a warm welcome every time.

I cannot recommend them enough!

Honestly, I'm writing this review with mixed emotions...
I came to this clinic as it's a bit more affordable than others in my area for consultation fee (82) and cuz of the usual great reviews. But I guess it depends which vet is treating your animal...

I would start by saying I think it's an overall not a bad clinic, but you should stay away from vets in the clinic who have less than 5 years of experience... My dog got seen by the vet Charles Courtemanche. While I believe he is not completely incompetent as a vet, I've to admit there may be much room for improvement....

I brought my dog for an exam cuz he has a little bit of hard time breathing after a long walk. Charles was very patient & examined the dog. At the end of examination, he said he's not sure what the issue is & asks permission to do some X-ray images (210) for my dog. He said he lacks tools for diagnosis before it's done... He kept saying it's imperative to do it asap.

I accepted to do X-rays to check the torso of my dog...despite the bill now becomes over 300 (82+210 plus tax)

After X-ray, he said my dog has partial obstructed airway issue & told me he recommends taking medication in the range of 250 plus taxes & asks me to spend over $1300 for the visit for various tests, blood work & to seek specialist opinion on the matter...

I found out from our conversation he has 2-3 years of experience as a vet max, so I insist he consults his colleagues for a second opinion before spending. He consulted Kate, a more experienced vet who did an examination on my dog & he said she agreed with his analysis.

Basically, at this point, Charles was saying to me repeatedly that it's extremely urgent I accept to buy the meds and do all of these things he recommends. He said it could be life-threatening for my pet in his current condition. I said my pet's smiling all the time & is healthy now, even though his breathing's a bit hard, but my dog's also very old.

At the end, I agreed to do the tests he recommends, but said paying for 1.3k is too much. So clinic agreed to give me the prescription for me to buy the meds elsewhere (& I end up getting the meds less than half of the price they were asking me). As the meds being bought elsewhere, the bill ends up being around 950$ instead. Why's this not a positive review, you ask? Cuz in the following days, while Charles has been a responsible animal doctor & called me back a to explain the results of the blood work & tests, what I find extremely upsetting & disappointing is that I nonetheless had to pay for the meds because of the wrong diagnosis from this vet cuz of how his impressions of how urgent the condition of my dog was incorrect! It WASN'T life threatening nor urgent. It didn't warrant me paying for 120 in meds for the dog for a condition that my dog did not have: partial obstructed airway that the vet believed my dog suffers from.

Over a week later, when he called me after all the blood work results, specialist opinion & opinions of his colleagues came back, he found out that my dog didn't have that condition & in fact even admitted in subsequent calls that asking me to buy medication was unnecessary. Me spending $120 was unnecessary & was a mistake! No credit for my next appointment, nothing of the sort being offered. Barely an apology.

I would say in retrospect Charles is not a good vet though he cares about the animal patients & loves what he does, but I believe he's lacking in experience & that leads him to urge all of us who have pets who see me to accept treatments & solutions from the clinic while it may not be necessary if you were seen by another vet with more experience. While I like Charles as a person & appreciate everything the clinic & Charles did for us, I believe IF I were to come back to this clinic again... I want to bring my dog to another vet & I strongly suggest you do the same, or else your wallet may be in great danger! THE LAST THING YOU WANT is to have the condition of your pet being misrepresented & lead you to spend your money while there's no need to do so...
My cat is always so well taken care here. I don't live nearby but I make the trip across the city.

Hands down best vet in town! @pointevet took over the care for my babies after a bad experience with another vet for 3 months. After returning to Pointe Vet (I took my first Savannah there), they delivered an exceptional experience and care 💯 ❤️ received such a great support by
Rose Gauthier, Technician Assistant
Stefanie Wosnitza, AHT

Elen (Ed) Depuis, AHT B.Sc

Vanessa Carter, Customer Support Representative

Veronica Cammisano, DVM

James Drooker, DVM (with my first Savannah, years ago)

Very affordable prices, genuine care for your animal, they give a thorough exam, and take the time to provide proper information and answer all questions. No surprises. They really go above and beyond and build a trust and relationship with their clients. Unlike many other vets, they also know exactly how to run a company and keep a high and  professional reputation.

I probably won't go anywhere else again.

Big thanks to the whole team! 🙌

The entire staff is kind, empathetic, and you can tell their love for animals. They do everything to avoid stressing the pets. Dr. Drooker has been our go-to vet for 9 years now, our cat loves him! He is kind, patient, and doesn't prescribe medicine without knowing what is really going on. He also did the teeth surgery on our kitty, and it was a great success!

Absolutely the best veterinary clinic. The entire staff is incredibly kind. They welcomed us, they supported my Junie throughout her entire journey, they were always amazing with her, very attentive and patient. Their priority is truly animal welfare!

I am very satisfied with the services I received from Dr. Drooker and his team. They are attentive, available, and offer excellent advice. Their customer service is outstanding. They are extremely responsive and proactive in addressing comments and questions, whether in person or by email.

So glad I discovered this clinic when my sweet angel got sick, dr. Floca and their whole team welcomed us with so much kindness empathy and genuine care. My experience at this clinic was outstanding despite the passing of my cat due to aggressive cancer. Thank you Dr.Floca for helping us in this extremely hard time 🌹 …

I just had to put down my dog of 17 years. It was a very sad moment for my girlfriend and I. We were treated kindly and given a small room off to the side away from everyone. The doctor who injected her was empathetic and put my girlfriend at ease. I know its a morbid topic to leave a review on but I think it might help anyone in the same position I was in. My little dog's lasts moments were not stressful which was very important to me.
Great service. Highly recommend.
Their prices are fair and their vets are knowledgeable. Their customer service is great.

A very nice clinic with dedicated team members. They give it to you straight when it comes to pricing, they give you options and they do not show any judgement.

I definitely recommend them!

First experience here was really great. The vet (male, possibly of German descent?) was so knowledgeable and his manner was fantastic. Reassuring, calm, and also a straight-shooter. No sugarcoating the truth, which I understand and appreciate.

I like how he got to know the situation first and shared all the normal info that he know of before the examination.

The other people working were also really great. Reception, clinician, all were friendly and supportive. Thanks so much! Glad we found out about you all.
best vet in Montreal
I trust this vet clinic so much! The staff are so sweet with your pets and the vets take the time to really go through the options with you! 10/10 recommend!
Very kind and empathetic staff who treated us and our little kitty with dignity and respect. We are definitely switching to this vet and highly recommend.

First time at this vet with my cat and a very positive experience. The vet listened attentively and took his time; I highly recommend them! Don't be fooled by the clinic's attractive appearance, which often comes with high prices: this clinic is one of the most affordable I've seen.
I’m just so grateful I found Pointe Vet for my dog. An empathetic & competent team & they make sure our visits feel good. Clinic is small and welcoming too.
Nice and straight forward but for sure very expensive

First time at this Clinic and my experience was awesome!
Professional and attentive staff. Affordable prices. Doctors are caring and take the time to explain everything. Thank you to everyone that took care of my dog, Peppy. Highly recommend!

Tina helped me so much with preparing my dog’s travel documents for France. She’s very knowledgeable, attentive to detail, and communicative. Very happy with the service at pointe vet. The prices are also more reasonable than other vets I’ve been to. Definitely recommend!
The staff were super friendly. The team treated our cats professionally and everyone was welcoming!

I would especially like to thank Dr. Floca and his incredible team who, beyond providing medical care, offered attentive follow-up, compassionate listening, and unwavering emotional support to me and Ghizmo. They accompanied him with dignity and supported me until his very last breath. Thank you for being there through the good times and the bad for our beloved four-legged companions.

We always receive excellent service at the Pointe-St-Charles veterinary clinic! Our dog Dobby loves going there!

We appreciate being able to book appointments directly online and also getting quick answers to our questions and concerns.
Best vet in Montreal! Always a good experience with Dr. Floca and all the clinic staff who are competent and quick to respond.
Very clean and professional. Very affordable price too, will definitely come back.
Compassionate care for reasonable prices. I was extremely worried about bringing my anxious cat in but they made me feel so at ease when I saw how they prioritized her comfort!

I have been with this clinic for some time, and they are the best. They are so thoughtful and considerate of their patients, and cost-conscious while also providing the best standards of care. I have recommended them to many friends with animal companions, and will continue to recommend them.

My dog is reactive (extremely excitable with other animals and new smells) and they have helped him with grace and kindness. I've never been made to feel badly for his difficult behavior, as we work on it.

Thank you to the whole team!

I hope whoever reads this considers NOT bringing their pet to this clinic and going somewhere else instead. I genuinely cannot believe how poor of experience this place was, after seeing other positive reviews on Google. I've never taken the time to write a poor review for a business before but, this deserves it.

I met with Dr.Floca for an infection on my cat's back to be looked at, to see if the antibiotic she had been taking for a couple weeks had been working. After about 40 minutes of being constantly cut-off and talked over when I was trying to ask some basic questions about her health, all he had done was re-shaven the infected area, re-open the wound that was close to fully healed, give her a lotion to use, and tell me to let the wound re-heal and re-scab. Even after directly asking, I was not told if the area still looks infected and they were not even willing to do a sample, either. So now I'm essentially back to the beginning, with an re-opened wound and an infection that still needs to be addressed, and will be bringing my pet to a different vet, this weekend, to actually be looked at with care.

I essentially just paid nearly $200 just for her scab to be re-opened, given no real answers or advice, and was then rushed out of the door. A complete waste of time, a complete waste of money, and worst of all my pet is actually worse-off for having come in today-- the exact opposite you expect from a vet. I would insist on getting my money, considering they essentially did nothing at all, but I am sure that will never happen. Do you, and especially your pet, a favour and simply go somewhere else.
